acceptance: forge new --dialect <any> produces a workspace whose TSX page serves its op's answer on first push; a CLI test and a dev-stack run.

author: rory
statement: forge new, for every dialect, scaffolds a TSX page with a loader calling the hello op and one TSX component beside the op, so a fresh workspace serves its op's answer through a TSX page on first push; and the portal's published docs carry the components guide generated from SUBSET-SKILL-TS's components section.
